summary: AkzoNobel filed a 6-K (foreign-private-issuer current report, US equivalent of an 8-K) disclosing European Commission conditional approval of its proposed all-stock merger of equals with Axalta Coating Systems (NYSE:AXTA). Terms are qualitative only: all-stock consideration, approximately $17 billion combined revenue, expected closing early 2027 pending remaining regulatory approvals. The remedy is divestment of AkzoNobel's European vehicle refinish business, removing EEA/UK/Switzerland horizontal overlap; no other competition issues identified. AkzoNobel CEO Greg Poux-Guillaume leads the combined company; Axalta's Chris Villavarayan becomes Deputy CEO. Watch the remaining regulatory clock and remedy-buyer execution; arbitrage hinges on approval sequencing and the divestiture's scope risk.
